plan.scope: For every existing language episode, replay both packaged CPO policies on the original eight-challenger rosters and their ordered two-challenger prefixes. Keep initial prompts, seeds, case splits and independent qualification. Compare the two-challenger policies with the frozen Promptolution native GEPA and halving settings on the same rosters. Resample paired cases by subject and reselect the strongest affordable control per draw. Measure whether the routed-versus-settled quality difference changes with roster width.
